resources.string: This app is getting ready for your classroom. Hub connection and saved lessons will be available in a later update.
Your classes will appear here after account setup and connection to your classroom Hub are available.
L.A.R.A. brings lessons and classroom activities to your device. This version sets up the app; account setup and classroom features are coming later.
Work will appear here when your teacher adds it. Choose All topics to see all saved classwork.
AI Tutor is unavailable while a quiz is in progress.
Hub unreachable. Showing what is saved on this device.
AI is not available right now.
Ask your teacher for the address shown on the Hub computer.
Checking: Please wait while we reach your Hub.
Check the address: Copy the numbers and optional port from your teacher, such as 192.168.1.50:8080.
Hub unavailable: Check the address with your teacher and try again.
Hub responding: The download page is reachable.
Hub disconnected: Join your classroom Wi-Fi, or enter the Hub address below.
Discovery interrupted: You can still enter the Hub address or try scanning again.
Searching: Looking for your classroom Hub.
No Hubs yet. Try scanning again or ask your teacher for the address.
Hubs found: Choose your classroom Hub below.
Learners can register here. Ask your Hub administrator for a teacher account.
Signing in to your classroom Hub...
Check your details: Enter your ID and four PIN digits. Learner registration needs a 12-digit LRN and full name.
First, choose your classroom Hub. Then sign in with your account.
Use the Hub on your classroom network, then enter your account details below.
Try again: Your ID or PIN did not match. Check them with your teacher if you need help.
Hub account: Administrators sign in on the Hub computer.
Account unavailable: This learner may already be registered, or this device has another saved account. Ask your teacher for help.
Please wait: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
Hub unreachable: Check the classroom Wi-Fi or use Find classroom Hub. Saved classroom work stays on this device.
Could not sign in: Please try again or ask your teacher for help.
Saved session unavailable: Sign in again to reopen your classroom.
Ask your teacher for the six-character class code, shown as XXX-XXX.
Check the code with your teacher. Use six letters or numbers without O, I, 0 or 1.
Hub unreachable: Connect to the classroom network before requesting to join. Saved classes remain available.
Could not send the request: Please try again or ask your teacher for help.
You are currently signed in as
Your teacher must approve your request before you can open the class.
Adding a class needs the Hub. Connect to the Hub and wait for any current request to finish.
Ask your teacher for a class code to get started.
Waiting for your teacher to approve
Approved. Waiting for your saved class to update.
Not approved. Ask your teacher for help.
Access removed. Ask your teacher for help.
Could not update class status: Your saved classes remain available. Try connecting to the Hub again.
Please sign in again to connect to the Hub. Your saved work stays on this device.
Could not update requests: reconnect to the Hub and try again.
Access unavailable: you cannot manage this class.
Learner details are not saved yet
Hub unavailable: saved requests are shown. Connect to accept or decline.
No saved classes. Connect to the Hub to update your class list.
No classes yet. Classes you teach will appear here.
Changing the Hub signs you out. Your saved work stays on this phone.
Your classroom, lessons and learning activities, available on the classroom network and saved for offline study.
Items waiting to sync: %1$d. They will stay saved on this phone. Sign in again with this account to send them when the Hub is reachable. Sign out now?
Hub unreachable: you can still sign out. Saved work stays on this phone.
Settings could not be saved. Please try again.
Connect to the Hub to make changes. Saved classes and people remain available.
Only the class owner can change these settings.
The change could not be confirmed. Refresh before trying again.
The request reached the Hub, but saved information could not be refreshed. Refresh before repeating the action.
Choose a name and section for this class. You will review the details before creating it.
Class name and section are required.
No saved learners in this class.
Archive this class? It becomes read-only for everyone. Grades are kept.
Remove this learner? They will lose access to the class. Their past scores are kept.
Remove this co-teacher from the class?
Create a class, share its code and manage your classroom people.
Share this code with learners. Their join requests still need your approval.
Check the name and section before creating your class.
No saved classes yet. Connect to the classroom Hub to update your classes.
This is where your class announcements will appear.
Your teacher’s lesson files will appear here. Open a handout while connected to save it for offline study.
Comments are turned off for this announcement.
No comments yet. Ask a question or share a thought.
Not sent. The Hub could not accept this comment; your copy is kept.
Could not save your comment. Your draft is still here.
Open handout · downloaded files stay available offline
Saved on this device · open handout
This file could not be displayed. Any saved lesson text is shown below.
The file is not available on this device yet. Connect to the classroom Hub and try again. Any saved lesson text is shown below.
This file has no extracted lesson text. The AI tutor is not available for it.
KEEP THE WHOLE PAGE IN VIEW
Allow the camera to photograph your notebook. You can also go back and choose a photo.
The camera could not open or save the photo. Try again, or choose a photo instead.
Photo ready. Tap Turn in to send this version.
Auto-adjusted preview. Check every line and drawing before using this photo.
Page edges were unclear, so this enhanced preview uses the full photo. Adjust corners if needed.
Page edges suggested. Check all four corners, then preview your scan.
No clear page edges found. Adjust the corners or use the full photo.
Document tools are unavailable on this device. You can use the full photo.
Document corners. Drag a corner or use the position controls below.
Place the corners around the page without crossing its edges.
The scan could not be prepared. Adjust the corners, try again, or use the full photo.
Queued for sync · Saved on this device
Your work is saved, but the Hub could not accept it. Ask your teacher for help.
Turned in · Your teacher has it
Your work will turn in by itself when you are connected to the classroom Hub.
Your photo could not be saved or turned in. Keep this screen open and try again.
Take a photo of your notebook page.
The deadline has passed. Ask your teacher whether late work can be accepted.
This homework has already been graded. Ask your teacher before replacing it.
Lesson video finished. You can play it again.
Download paused. Your progress is saved.
Saved on this device · Plays without the Hub
Not connected to Hub. Saved videos still work. Reconnect to stream or continue saving.
This video is unavailable offline. Return to classwork or reconnect to the Hub and retry.
Sign in to the Hub again to stream or save this lesson. Saved videos still work.
The lesson could not be saved. Check free device storage, then resume.
This video could not be played or saved. Retry, or ask your teacher to check the lesson file.
The lesson changed while saving. Return to classwork and try saving it again.
Remove this video from your phone? You can save it again when you\'re on the classroom network.
Your photo will be saved on this device and sent when the classroom Hub is reachable.
Make this class read-only for everyone. Materials, work and grades are kept.
